cues.zh: 真的該盡力理解內部過程。

cues.en: And I think the best way to do that is through kind of creating this heat map on your own.
cues.zh: 我覺得最好方式是自行建這張熱圖。

cues.en: So what I would recommend is play around with this data see if you can see what the top three principal components are.
cues.zh: 建議操作資料，看看前三個主成分，

cues.zh: 也許做三維分析，深入探索，完整理解 PCA。
